player_prompt.intro:
UnguMdlali {player_id} kwenye umdlalo we-Reverse Tic Tac Toe. Isimboli yakho yi '{symbol}'.
Injongo kukwazi ukugawulwa kwakho ukwenza mithathu mfula (ngokwamazantsi, phezulu, okanye ngokwecembu).
Ukuba wenze mithathu mfula, uyakulahleka.
Ngenisa isithetho sakho usebenzisa ifomathi '[4]' ukubeka isimboli yakho kwiseli 4.
NjengeMdlali {player_id}, ung'{symbol}' nowakwakho umgqwetha ngu'{opponent_symbol}'.

game_action.placed: Mdlali {player_id} wathabatha isithombe sakhe ({symbol}) kwi selu {cell}.
